Expeditions

Reef Check California

Measuring the shape of underwater study plots

Location: Monterey, California.

Year: 2021.

Organization: Reef Check California.

My role: underwater photogrammetry surveys and surface-area estimation from 3D reconstructions.

For an urchin remediation study, I used underwater photogrammetry to estimate the surface area of rugose plots with uneven, complex surfaces.

Supporting the study

I documented plots and estimated their surface area.

From field images to measurements

Photographs became 3D models whose geometry supported plot-area estimates.

Connecting fieldwork, research, and design

My work brings together experience in product design, underwater research, and scientific publishing. I'm interested in ecological change, deep time, and how people participate in thriving ecosystems across generations.
